import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import brentq

def read_xyz(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        n = int(f.readline()); f.readline()
        elems, coords = [], []
        for _ in range(n):
            p = f.readline().split()
            elems.append(p[0]); coords.append([float(p[1]), float(p[2]), float(p[3])])
    return elems, np.array(coords)

def unit(v): return v/np.linalg.norm(v)

# ---------- load fragments ----------
arm_el, arm_xyz = read_xyz("frag_arm.xyz")       # 15 atoms; 0=N2,1=N1,9=C3,14=H(on N1)
cb_el, cb_xyz   = read_xyz("frag_carbene.xyz")   # 36 atoms; 5=carbeneC,6=O(remove),4=C4fur,7=CipsoAnis

# ---------- solve arm geometry in (rho,z) plane ----------
R_AgN = 2.30      # Ag-N2
ang_AgNN = np.radians(112.0)   # Ag-N2-N1
R_BN  = 1.55      # B-N1
ang_BNN = np.radians(120.0)    # B-N1-N2
N2f = arm_xyz[0]; N1f = arm_xyz[1]
d_NN = np.linalg.norm(N1f-N2f)  # ~1.32

def place_B(alpha):
    N2 = np.array([R_AgN*np.sin(alpha), R_AgN*np.cos(alpha)])  # (rho,z)
    # direction N2->Ag
    th = np.arctan2(-N2[1], -N2[0])
    # rotate by -112 deg to point N2->N1 (up/inward)
    th1 = th - ang_AgNN
    N1 = N2 + d_NN*np.array([np.cos(th1), np.sin(th1)])
    # direction N1->N2
    th2v = np.arctan2(N2[1]-N1[1], N2[0]-N1[0])
    # rotate by -120 deg to point N1->B (toward axis)
    thB = th2v - ang_BNN
    B = N1 + R_BN*np.array([np.cos(thB), np.sin(thB)])
    return N2, N1, B

def f(alpha):
    _,_,B = place_B(alpha)
    return B[0]  # want rho(B)=0

alpha = brentq(f, np.radians(50), np.radians(65), xtol=1e-12)
N2rz, N1rz, Brz = place_B(alpha)
print(f"alpha = {np.degrees(alpha):.2f} deg")
print(f"N2 (rho,z) = {N2rz}, |Ag-N2| = {np.linalg.norm(N2rz):.3f}")
print(f"N1 (rho,z) = {N1rz}, |N1-N2| = {np.linalg.norm(N1rz-N2rz):.3f}")
print(f"B  (rho,z) = {Brz}, |B-N1| = {np.linalg.norm(Brz-N1rz):.3f}, B..Ag = {Brz[1]:.3f}")

def to3D(rz, phi):
    return np.array([rz[0]*np.cos(phi), rz[0]*np.sin(phi), rz[1]])

# ---------- build rotation from fragment frame to target frame ----------
def frame_from(p0, p1, p2):
    # origin p0; e1 toward p1; e2 in plane toward p2 perp to e1
    e1 = unit(p1-p0)
    v = p2-p0
    e2 = unit(v - np.dot(v,e1)*e1)
    e3 = np.cross(e1,e2)
    return np.column_stack([e1,e2,e3])  # 3x3, columns are basis vectors

atoms = []   # (elem, xyz)
azimuths = [np.radians(90), np.radians(210), np.radians(330)]
for phi in azimuths:
    N2t = to3D(N2rz, phi); N1t = to3D(N1rz, phi)
    Ff = frame_from(arm_xyz[0], arm_xyz[1], arm_xyz[9])   # origin N2, e1->N1, e2->C3
    # target frame: e1' = unit(N1t-N2t); ring plane contains z-axis & Ag; e2' points away from Ag
    e1p = unit(N1t-N2t)
    v = N2t - np.dot(N2t,e1p)*e1p   # radially outward from Ag, perp to N1-N2 -> ring interior side
    e2p = unit(v)
    e3p = np.cross(e1p,e2p)
    Ft = np.column_stack([e1p,e2p,e3p])
    R = Ft @ Ff.T
    for i,(el,xyz) in enumerate(zip(arm_el, arm_xyz)):
        if i == 14:   # skip N1-H
            continue
        atoms.append((el, R @ (xyz - arm_xyz[0]) + N2t))

# Ag, B, B-H
atoms.append(("Ag", np.array([0.0,0.0,0.0])))
Bpos = np.array([0.0,0.0,Brz[1]])
atoms.append(("B", Bpos))
atoms.append(("H", Bpos + np.array([0.0,0.0,1.19])))

# ---------- carbene fragment ----------
# remove ketone O (index 6)
keep = [i for i in range(len(cb_el)) if i != 6]
cb_el2 = [cb_el[i] for i in keep]
cb_xyz2 = cb_xyz[keep]
# new index of carbene C (old 5) and its substituent neighbors (old 4 -> 4, old 7 -> 6)
ic = 4  # old index 5 shifted by 1
iC4 = 3 # old index 4 shifted by 1... wait old 4 < 6 so stays 4? No: old indices <6 unchanged
EOF
